summary: Delta review of c88d72a92a78..005ad95978e8. All earlier findings are fixed. T-7 now compares each Tab stop's focused outline and box-shadow with its resting look; in a scratch copy, removing the outline on #play or .mode makes T-7 fail, and removing all focus styling makes it fail on the first stop. T-8 now checks every visible element of the card against 0..375 and that card.scrollWidth <= clientWidth; injecting a wider .row grid makes it fail. kbd is 12px, and no other menu text is under 12px. Chromium launch is inside try/finally, so the server is always killed. Bus stands now share the roadside fallback with police stations (findRoadsideSpot, with byEdge for stands); the police path is behaviourally unchanged. test/bus-stands.test.js covers all three towns, and with the roadside bus stand path removed it fails for Pulivendula at 4.8 tiles. GLOSSARY, both READMEs and the YARD constant are done. npm test (46), npm run e2e (3) and design_check (no findings) are clean. The unlock of test/bus-stands.test.js is justified: the edge-distance helper is a deliberate, judge-directed reading for a junction node, and it was shown to bite. Two nits remain.

findings.issue: Edge distance is weaker than the original middle-of-building check for the plaza stands in Kadapa and Punganur: a 5x4 stand placed by the NEAR_REACH fallback (middle up to 8 tiles away) can still pass. Only Pulivendula's junction node needs edge distance.
findings.fix: Optional: keep edge distance only where the mapped station is a junction node, or also assert the stand's middle is within NEAR_REACH.

findings.issue: If browser.close() throws, server.kill() in the same finally is skipped and the run hangs on the open pipe.
findings.fix: Nest the two in try/finally, or call server.kill() first.
